scenario:
A large multinational organization is implementing an enterprise-level Project Management and Milestone Tracking System. This platform is designed to manage and monitor the progress of multiple projects across various departments and regions. Each project comprises several milestones, which are critical checkpoints that must be achieved to ensure the project's success.

The system allows project managers to define milestones, set due dates, and specify project deliverables. It tracks whether these milestones are achieved and provides detailed reporting on project progress. The platform supports complex projects that may involve multiple teams, external partners, and a variety of deliverables, such as reports, datasets, and software components.

Additionally, the system includes advanced features for resource allocation, risk management, and communication among stakeholders. It integrates with existing tools like email, calendars, and document management systems to streamline project workflows. The platform should also offer customizable dashboards and analytics tools for project managers to visualize progress, identify bottlenecks, and make data-driven decisions.

The organization requires robust user roles and permissions to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify project details and milestone statuses. The platform should also support historical data analysis to evaluate past project performances and improve future project planning.
